paragraphs.en: Good morning, my friends. Today I am going to say something about small words. When I was a child, I took a book from my father's shelf. The words were long and hard, and I stopped reading after one page.
paragraphs.zh: 朋友们，早上好。今天我想谈谈小词。小时候，我从父亲的书架上拿了一本书。书里的词又长又难，我读了一页就停下了。

paragraphs.en: Then my mother gave me a different book. It had only simple words, but the stories were full of light. I went on reading till the sun went down, and I was happier than ever before.
paragraphs.zh: 后来，母亲给了我另一本书。书里只有简单的词，但故事里满是光亮。我一直读到太阳落山，比以往任何时候都快乐。

paragraphs.en: Simple words are like boxes. They are small, but you may put great things into them: love, hope, and the way to a new country.
paragraphs.zh: 简单的词就像盒子。它们很小，却能装下伟大的东西：爱、希望，以及通往新国度的道路。

paragraphs.en: So do not be afraid of simple language. Say what you see, and say it clearly. Every word you learn today is a step on the road to tomorrow. Thank you.
paragraphs.zh: 所以，不要害怕简单的语言。把你看到的说出来，说清楚。今天学会的每一个词，都是通往明天之路上的一步。谢谢大家。

paragraphs.en: Dear teachers and friends, I have a question for you. Why do we keep learning when we are no longer in school?
paragraphs.zh: 亲爱的老师和朋友们，我想问大家一个问题：当我们不再上学时，为什么还要继续学习？

paragraphs.en: My answer is simple. Learning keeps the mind awake. When we read, we see the world through other people's eyes. When we listen, we make a bridge between two hearts.
paragraphs.zh: 我的答案很简单。学习让头脑保持清醒。阅读时，我们透过别人的眼睛看世界；聆听时，我们在两颗心之间架起一座桥。

paragraphs.en: Last year I made a small rule: ten new words every day. Some days were hard, and some days I got tired. But little by little, the words came together, and now I'm able to read a newspaper in English.
paragraphs.zh: 去年我给自己定了一条小规矩：每天学十个新词。有些日子很难，有些日子我很累。但一点一点地，这些词连成了一片，现在我已经能读英文报纸了。

paragraphs.en: Learning is not a race. It is a long, quiet walk. Go slowly, but go every day, and you will be surprised how far you have come.
paragraphs.zh: 学习不是赛跑，而是一段漫长而安静的步行。慢慢走，但每天都走，你会惊讶自己已经走了多远。
